_comment: Operations board aesthetic — Star Trek TNG / LCARS. Saturated orange + cream + lavender + yellow on pure black, condensed-bold display type. Pill-chip-and-bracket framing. Refs/ops/ holds LCARS asset-prep + Titan.DS Spacedock frames extracted 2026-05-23 from System47/meWho's catalog (see design-references.md). Pre-2026-05-23 cell bg was #000044 navy — true LCARS uses pure #000000 black, the blue tint muddied the saturated pill chips. cat[2] was #cc5599 dark magenta; canonical TNG lavender is #cc99ff.

data._comment: LCARS canonical palette in display order: orange (primary), cream, lavender, yellow, salmon, red. Reads instantly as TNG ops board — saturated flat fills, no shading. Unlike vigil/hackers/hailmary (cyan-dominant ladder), LCARS intentionally uses bold-color diversity as its aesthetic primary; the 'don't saturate cat[1..2]' rule does NOT apply here.

type.body: "Antonio", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Helvetica Neue Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
type.head: "Antonio", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

palette._comment: stroke1/2/3 align with data.cat[0..2] so the same logical role (primary/secondary/tertiary) resolves to the same color across vega categorical, scene3d wireframes, and animated_svg $token substitution. Orange + cream + lavender = the iconic LCARS bracket-color triplet.
